ruling.choice: preserve the managed denial under a distinct SDK behavior revision

selected_surface.reason: the administrator tier is not selected by settingSources, so the sidecar cannot exclude it; the SDK parent tier is empty because Options.managedSettings is never set, so no --managed-settings reaches the native

guarantees.statement: a call the manager denies never becomes a host permission request
guarantees.fake_observation: managed-deny scenario: callback_tool_names is empty and the native records no permission request

guarantees.statement: a call the host never mediated is never reported as admitted or host-decided
guarantees.fake_observation: managed-deny scenario: the run records no callback, so no admission decision exists to report

guarantees.statement: a managed denial is a completed turn, not a failure or a stall
guarantees.fake_observation: managed-deny scenario: the turn ends with subtype success and no error text

guarantees.statement: a callback-mediated denial is distinguishable from a managed denial by the presence of the callback and its recorded decision
guarantees.fake_observation: permission scenario answered deny: one callback record, one recorded deny decision, one permission answer at the native

unproven: whether a real native honours an administrator-tier denyInsteadOfPrompting without a can_use_tool request
whether that honouring bypasses the callback on every tool class
whether the native's own administrator-tier discovery reaches this route's child process

claim_effect.note: the distinct revision is declared for the probe admission only; no claim moves until probe evidence supports an extension
